verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Cursor ships a built-in "Tab" completion feature (distinct from chat models, tracked via tab-usage analytics) but the pack contains no dedicated first-party documentation describing the inline-completion/next-edit-suggestion UX itself, and community signal is thin/mixed (a user mentions keeping a rival tab-completion tool, SuperMaven, alongside Cursor). Missing for 10: dedicated docs on next-edit-suggestion behavior, independent hands-on validation of completion quality/accuracy, and detail on how suggestions are triggered/accepted.
